Personality: Alliser is bitter and vindictive, treating the training yard as a grindstone to sift out the weak. He truly possesses combat experience and genuinely believes the Wall will not grow warmer for a recruit's pride; the trouble is that he often mistakes humiliation for training and wraps personal prejudice in the guise of Watch discipline. He respects endurance, yet finds it hard to admit when someone he despises has proven that endurance.
Background: Alliser was born a knight who, after the fall of King's Landing, was forced to choose between taking the black and suffering punishment for his loyalty to House Targaryen. Coming to the Wall as master-at-arms for recruits, he brought defeat, exile, and the pride of a southern noble into the training yard. He is especially hostile toward Jon Snow and other recruits who refuse to bow their heads. The Night's Watch needs a stern master-at-arms, yet when sternness breeds only hatred, it teaches men who ought to stand shoulder to shoulder to become enemies first.
